name: cheatykitty
description: Privacy-conscious macOS overlay that uses Codex CLI and Apple Vision OCR to suggest answers to visible study questions
author: CheatyKitty contributors

scripts.clean: rm -rf artifacts build coverage dist release
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run verify:hygiene && npm run build && npm run smoke
scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-icon.mjs && node scripts/verify-icon.mjs && node scripts/prepare-build.mjs && tsc && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.visual:capture: npm run build && electron scripts/capture-ui.cjs busy && electron scripts/capture-ui.cjs answer-only && electron scripts/capture-ui.cjs answer-only-busy && electron scripts/capture-ui.cjs answer-only-thinking && electron scripts/capture-ui.cjs answer-only-error && electron scripts/capture-ui.cjs result && electron scripts/capture-ui.cjs settings
scripts.visual:capture:busy: npm run build && electron scripts/capture-ui.cjs busy
scripts.visual:capture:result: npm run build && electron scripts/capture-ui.cjs result
scripts.visual:capture:settings: npm run build && electron scripts/capture-ui.cjs settings
scripts.visual:capture:readme: npm run build && electron scripts/capture-ui.cjs ready && electron scripts/capture-ui.cjs demo-capturing && electron scripts/capture-ui.cjs demo-thinking && electron scripts/capture-ui.cjs demo-result && electron scripts/capture-ui.cjs settings
scripts.verify:codex:preset: npm run build && node scripts/integration-codex.mjs gpt-5.6-sol
scripts.verify:codex:spark: npm run build && node scripts/integration-codex.mjs gpt-5.3-codex-spark medium letter && node scripts/integration-codex.mjs gpt-5.3-codex-spark medium numeric
scripts.verify:runtime:packaged: node scripts/packaged-runtime-e2e.mjs gpt-5.6-luna letter degraded-ocr && node scripts/packaged-runtime-e2e.mjs gpt-5.6-sol letter degraded-ocr && node scripts/packaged-runtime-e2e.mjs gpt-5.3-codex-spark letter && node scripts/packaged-runtime-e2e.mjs gpt-5.3-codex-spark numeric
scripts.verify:runtime:stress: node scripts/packaged-runtime-e2e.mjs gpt-5.6-luna it-output && node scripts/packaged-runtime-e2e.mjs gpt-5.6-luna it-promises && node scripts/packaged-runtime-e2e.mjs gpt-5.6-sol it-snapshot && node scripts/packaged-runtime-e2e.mjs gpt-5.6-sol it-rust && node scripts/packaged-runtime-e2e.mjs gpt-5.3-codex-spark it-typescript && node scripts/packaged-runtime-e2e.mjs gpt-5.3-codex-spark it-sql && node scripts/packaged-runtime-e2e.mjs gpt-5.3-codex-spark it-network
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare:electron-runtime && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64

extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: CheatyKitty captures visible on-screen questions when you use the Manual shortcut or enable Auto capture.
